What problem does classroom execution and what problem does record handover each solve?

Classroom execution focuses on how the original plan was turned into the day's activities, and record handover focuses on what was completed, what was not and who continues to check. The two are related, but holding an activity does not mean all students have mastered it, and an absence or uncollected material must not be filled in as leave or as submitted.

The number collected and knowledge mastery are different. Without an assignment, an assessment or a confirmation basis, keep it unknown, do not assign a grade yourself and do not equate non-submission with unwillingness to learn.
What still needs to be checked when the original teacher returns?
Taking over｜Original lesson plan and scope check｜Clarify the original activities, materials, class rules and school division of work and understand what may be adjusted.
Explaining｜Teaching organization and question time｜Explain the activities, answer questions and assist learning under the corresponding stage and subject and the school requirements.
Supervision｜Classroom and extracurricular activities｜Watch order and activity progress under the school arrangement and check duties with the responsible person when they are unclear.

Records｜Attendance and material distribution and collection｜Keep attendance and the distribution and collection quantities as required, and do not fill an unknown attendance in as leave or an uncollected material as submitted.
Handover｜The day's progress and to-dos｜Report the activities carried out, the problems and the remaining arrangements to the original teacher, with a clear source and without exaggerating completion.
Learning｜Feedback and professional training｜Accept teacher or school feedback and keep building subject, explanation and record ability, with the qualification checked separately.
Section title｜Classroom and collaboration in short-term cover

O*NET lists classroom rules, teaching and question time, attendance and break and lunch activity supervision. The specific duties vary with the school stage and the cover arrangement, and no uniform daily lesson count or class size is given.

Organizations and sites｜Work may take place in different classrooms or activity areas at a school, and the report location and supervision scope are checked against the real task. A half-year maternity leave cover and an 11-month temporary hire in China cannot be treated as the same system as daily short-term cover in the US.

Materials and tools｜The original lesson plan, textbooks and worksheets, attendance records, school communication and audio-visual and computer tools support teaching. Having the tools does not mean access to all student materials or permission to change the school plan on your own.

Organization｜Short-term cover for a regular teacher, possibly assisting individual or group learning. The actual class arrangement and support staff are confirmed by the school, and you do not take on unclear tasks out of personal willingness.

Scheduling and pressure｜Check the short-notice call, the consecutive cover term, break and lunch supervision, lesson preparation and commuting, and the paid hours. The work has both fixed and irregular arrangements and does not guarantee stable daily teaching or full-year pay.

Team communication｜Check the requirements with the original teacher or the responsible person before taking over and leave activity feedback and to-dos afterwards. The handover cannot treat the original plan as the day's facts, nor let an unknown status become confirmed as it is passed on.

Review and responsibility｜Teaching qualifications, student protection and school rules continue to apply. Exploration does not contact real people or rehearse student safety incidents, and real problems are handed to authorized personnel under school rules.

Quality requirements｜Clear explanation, accurate records, traceable progress, a lawful material scope and clear to-dos. Something happening in class and a student mastering it are different, and real teaching evaluation is still needed.

A tutor provides individual or group tutoring, learning plans and feedback, which is not the same as daily cover of a whole class.

values: F1 | Five complete inputs and eight judgments

All original fiction, with no real students, classroom or evaluations. L1 original lesson plan: 40 minutes, with 8 for the warm-up, 12 for the pair activity, 15 for the worksheet and 5 for the wrap-up. R1 same-day record: 8 for the warm-up, 12 for the pair activity, 10 for the worksheet and 5 for the wrap-up, 35 minutes in total, explicitly noting that 5 minutes of the worksheet remained unfinished. A1 four fictional codes: A/B/C arrived, D's attendance status unconfirmed. W1: two worksheets from A/B collected, C did not submit, D's status unknown. H1 the original teacher's request: report the actual activities, the unfinished parts and the status of attendance materials; no evaluation of any student's learning was given.

Eight items: (a) the plan is 40 minutes; (b) the actual is 35 minutes; (c) the worksheet still has 5 minutes left; (d) 3 arrived; (e) 2 were collected; (f) D has confirmed leave; (g) all students have mastered the content; (h) the whole 40-minute plan is complete. First judge each item independently as supported or unsupported and write the input source for each. An incorrect handover draft: 'every item's 40-minute plan is fully complete, D is on leave, and all students have mastered the content.' Find the three unsupported statements, then write your own first version.
F2 | The A and B feedback and the F3 statement

A: write planned versus actual time, and completed versus remaining activities, separately; at least two changes relative to the first version with reasons. B: keep confirmed versus unknown attendance, and materials collected versus learning outcomes, separate; independently review the first version and make at least two changes with reasons, keeping both the A and B versions.

F3: list the fictional originals of the task text on this page, your own eight judgments and writing, that the A and B feedback was supplied by the editor, and whether and how AI actually took part; there are no real-person materials or class recordings, and nothing is sent to schools or made public; do not write that you obtained a teacher qualification or have teaching experience.
Reference deliverable | 5 supported, 3 unsupported

(a) L1 supports 40; (b) R1 supports 35; (c) L1/R1 supports the explicit 5 remaining unfinished; (d) A1 supports 3 arrived; (e) W1 supports 2 collected; (f) A1 only has D unknown and does not support leave; (g) H1 gives no evaluation and W1 only gives a count, so they do not support mastery; (h) R1 records an actual 35 with 5 unfinished, which does not support completion of the whole plan. The 5 supported and 3 unsupported refer only to the task text, not to external truthfulness verification.

A example: change 'all 40 minutes completed' to planned 40 and actual 35 (R1); add that 5 minutes of the worksheet remain to be continued (L1/R1); the reason for both is that a plan cannot substitute for execution and that remaining tasks must be handed over. B example: change D on leave to status unconfirmed (A1); change whole-class mastery to two collected, C not submitted, D unknown and no evaluation of learning (W1/H1). Do not add student behaviour, grades or reasons for absence. F3 truthfully lists your own work and AI's actual participation.

description.text: In the United States, on this page substitute teacher refers to the work of short-term replacement of a permanent classroom teacher, usually organizing learning according to the original teacher's lesson plan and handling question-answering, attendance records, activity supervision and the same-day handover. The key is to understand the class arrangements quickly and execute and give feedback accurately, rather than hastily rewriting the whole curriculum. The appointment term, qualifications and contract of Chinese temporary cover posts and longer-term non-establishment teachers are checked separately, and the bare label of substituting is not enough to assume the systems are the same.
